skills.title: Markov spectral gaps and Ising Glauber dynamics

skills.name: probability-measure-convergence

skills.name: probability-spectral-perturbation-certificates
skills.title: Spectral perturbation and strict gap certificates
skills.description: Audit a parameterized family of finite reversible chains or other finite-dimensional spectral problems for eigenvalue crossings, derivatives, Poisson response, changing stationary measures or rigorous parameter intervals.
